thread:
Maya Patel: quick design check — noticed a11y and copy things in the routing rules panel when testing the preview simulation earlier
Liam Chen: nailed down a few, got time now to run through? :eyes:
Maya Patel: yes, short list:
Maya Patel: 1) The rule card labels are ambiguous — 'Priority' vs 'Order' used in different places
Samir Rao: agreed. my vote: use 'Priority' everywhere, since backend and engineer docs use that term
Eva Gomez: +1 for consistency. also the preview topbar says 'Playback' which confused PMs — maybe 'Preview Simulation'
Maya Patel: 2) Validation copy: when rules overlap we show: "Rule conflict detected" — can we be more actionable
Liam Chen: propose: "Conflict: this rule overlaps with rule #3 (same condition). Reorder or adjust condition to resolve."
Samir Rao: love the specificity. can we include a quick link to the conflicting rule in the message? e.g., [Go to rule #3]
Maya Patel: yes — link opens the rule drawer
Eva Gomez: 3) keyboard nav: Tab order currently lands in the card but skips the priority handle. keyboard users can't reorder
Liam Chen: important — should expose the reorder handle as a button with aria-label="Move rule" and support up/down arrow keys when focused
DesignBot: accessibility-check: recommended role="button" and aria-grabbed updates for reorder interactions
Maya Patel: 4) color contrast: small badge text ("active") on gray 300 fails AA for 12px. Increase weight or swap to darker gray
Samir Rao: also consider using an icon+text, with icon as decorative (aria-hidden) and text visible to screen readers
Eva Gomez: 5) preview mismatch: when you toggle 'simulate caching' the preview shows token time but not batch size — PM wants visible batch size and latency estimate
Liam Chen: we can add a compact stats row in preview: "Batch: 8 | Est latency: 120ms | Cache hit: 32%"
Maya Patel: copy tweaks:
Maya Patel: - Button: "Save rules" -> "Save and apply" (makes action immediate)
Maya Patel: - Tooltip for rules: "Applies to incoming requests that match this condition" -> "Applied at request routing time; affects which model/region is used."
Samir Rao: small nit: hover state for rule cards is very subtle. maybe increase elevation and add 2px border to emphasize focus
Eva Gomez: one more: validation modal currently blocks but only lists 1 error. for multiple errors show summary + inline anchors to each rule
Liam Chen: implementation detail: the validator runs client-side, can return an array of {ruleId, message, severity}. UI should render inline anchors
Maya Patel: ok action items
Maya Patel: - Liam to implement aria attributes + keyboard reorder (owner)
Maya Patel: - Samir to adjust contrast and hover/focus visuals (owner)
Maya Patel: - Eva to update copy strings and preview stats row (owner)
Maya Patel: - I'll draft the more specific validation messages and link UX
Samir Rao: I can mock the hover states and send figma link
Liam Chen: I'll add tests for keyboard reordering and write a small E2E for preview stats
DesignBot: visual-regression: queued snapshot for rule-panel-v3 after hover changes
Eva Gomez: thanks team — can we aim for a small patch for the beta next week? :calendar:
Maya Patel: yes targeting next Wednesday
Liam Chen: noted
Samir Rao: sending figma in a bit
Maya Patel: thanks all :heart:
